description:
Lab49 is an award winning specialist consultancy that creates bespoke technology in partnership with the most important companies in finance.

We were founded in 2002 to bring Silicon Valley solutions to Wall Street’s door. Since then, we have worked on successive waves of technological change, including distributed computing, high-speed automation, enterprise UX and digital distribution (for which Lab49 was among the first significant practices established on Wall Street), DevOps, cloud and data science.

Today, we are an established partner in financial markets, having delivered hundreds of projects for clients including all the world’s tier-one investment banks and many of the largest buy-side firms globally.

Being part of Lab49 means bringing your drive and creativity into an environment where your contributions will make immediate impact. Engineers work in cross functional teams, consulting directly with our clients, shaping not only technical solutions to business problems but delivering them into production.

We are seeking a Product Manager, who will be working with our clients in the high frequency trading space. One who has the ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with engineers, designers, HR professionals and other stakeholders; .

### **Responsibilities**

* Communication and Collaboration Skills: Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with engineers, designers, HR professionals and other stakeholders; should be comfortable facilitating discussions and working on cross-functional teams.
* Process Design: Lead sessions to understand current state processes and pain points; leverage this analysis and understand key requirements to help shape the future state process design and gain alignment across HCM and business stakeholders.
* Analytical Skills and Data Acumen: Strong analytical skills to interpret data, identify trends, and support data-driven decision-making. They should be comfortable working with spreadsheets and other reporting tools to analyze data.
* Requirements gathering and documentation acumen: Ability to gather, document and clearly articulate product requirements (i.e., user stories, data migration requirements, etc.).
* Technical Aptitude: Candidate should have a basic understanding of software development principles and be comfortable working with technical teams.
* Test Strategy & Execution: Work with functional and technical teams to shape the end-to-end testing strategy, spanning functional test and UAT; help test solution rigorously (along with HCM and business stakeholders) to surface and resolve critical defects ahead of a program’s launch
* Project & Change Management: Help project manage key deliverables, while helping execute against an innovative communication and training strategy – from drafting stakeholder messaging to creating high-quality learning collateral
* Understanding of Total Rewards Concepts (optional – specific to Rewards pillar): A foundational understanding of total rewards principles, including compensation structures, benefits packages (health, retirement, etc.), and other employee benefits is ideal.
* Oracle Core experience (optional): Foundational knowledge and understanding of Oracle HRIS including data management, system optimization and functionality

**Why Lab49?**

Lab49 is an established partner for most financial institutions on Wall Street. You will gain exposure into a variety of environments, business domains, technologies, and people. Your ability to bring drive and creativity to the role will be the key component to success at Lab49. The broad and intense exposure to a variety of challenges accelerates your career growth, and Lab49’s structure is designed to enable you to learn and grow as an engineer and consultant.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

description:
Designation: NA

Location: India Maharashtra Goregaon R Tech

Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Description: Product Manager – UPI & BBPS**

**Experience:** 2–3 Years
  
**Department:** Digital Payments / Product Management
  
**Industry:** Fintech / Digital Payments

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Product Manager to manage and enhance UPI and BBPS (Bharat Connect) journeys, drive product execution, and improve onboarding, transaction success, and customer experience. The role involves close collaboration with engineering, QA, design, analytics, operations, compliance, and banking partners to deliver seamless, reliable, and compliant payment experiences.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Management & Delivery**

* Translate business requirements into PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and product specifications.
* Manage product backlogs, JIRA, sprint planning, UAT, releases, and post-release monitoring.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver product enhancements and resolve production issues.
* Support roadmap execution, competitor benchmarking, and feature prioritization.

**2. UPI & BBPS Product Management**

* Manage UPI journeys, including onboarding, device binding, SIM verification, bank account linking, UPI ID creation, UPI PIN setup, and payments.
* Drive UPI feature enhancements, including UPI Lite and other applicable capabilities.
* Manage BBPS journeys across bill categories, including biller integration, bill fetch, payment processing, status checks, refunds, reversals, and complaints.
* Coordinate with PSP banks, billers, aggregators, and technology partners to resolve issues and improve transaction performance.
* Support implementation of applicable RBI, NPCI, and Bharat Connect guidelines.

**3. Product Analytics & Performance**

* Configure and validate product events in Mixpanel and GA4 in collaboration with engineering and analytics teams.
* Analyze funnels, cohorts, retention, and drop-offs across onboarding, activation, UPI transactions, and bill payments.
* Track key metrics such as registration conversion, device-binding success, transaction success rates, technical declines, API latency, bill-fetch success, and repeat usage.
* Build performance dashboards and conduct root-cause analysis to identify product gaps and drive measurable improvements.
* Use Excel and, preferably, SQL/BigQuery or BI tools for data analysis and reporting.
  

**4. Customer Experience & Stakeholder Management**

* Identify friction points through customer feedback, complaints, and journey analysis; recommend improvements to reduce drop-offs and payment failures.
* Coordinate with engineering, QA, operations, risk, compliance, and banking partners on integrations, testing, releases, and issue resolution.
* Maintain product documentation, process flows, test scenarios, and release notes.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 2–3 years of experience in product management, business analysis, or product execution, preferably in fintech or digital payments.
* Working knowledge of UPI, BBPS/Bharat Connect, payment flows, and customer onboarding journeys.
* Hands-on experience with Mixpanel and/or GA4, including event tracking, funnel analysis, and conversion metrics.
* Familiarity with JIRA, Agile methodologies, PRDs, user stories, and UAT.
* Basic understanding of REST APIs, JSON, API testing, and system integrations.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

**Good to Have:** Basic SQL/BigQuery, Power BI or similar tools; exposure to Android/iOS applications, PSP banks, TPAPs, biller aggregators, reconciliation, refunds, and transaction monitoring.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Onboarding, UPI activation, and first-transaction conversion.
* UPI and BBPS transaction success rates.
* Device-binding, bank-linking, and bill-fetch success rates.
* Reduction in transaction failures, technical declines, and funnel drop-offs.
* Feature adoption, repeat transactions, and customer experience.
* Timely delivery of product enhancements and resolution of production issues.

**Ideal Candidate:** A data-driven product professional with a strong understanding of digital payments, product analytics, customer journeys, and cross-functional execution.

description:
**About Tekion:**
-----------------

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

**What You’ll Do**
  
  

* Keep your integrations healthy and best-in-class: Define what “good” looks like for your integration pattern, measure it in our Integration Platform (Tekion’s internal health-monitoring system), and drive coverage, reliability, and quality up across all your integrations - benchmarking each against the best competing product in the market.

  

* Win on AI-powered delivery: Shift your pattern from hand-built integrations toward ones generated with Tekion’s AI-assisted build tools (internally, APC Studio), help sharpen the AI tools you depend on, and own a complete, living set of requirements that any engineering team can build from.

  

* Drive revenue through OEM certifications: Lead integration patterns toward successful OEM certification so OEM-approved integrations can be adopted by dealers at scale. Drive adoption and reduce support load: Make your integrations easy to install and switch on, raise dealership uptake where it is low, and reduce support tickets by tracking and fixing root causes.

  

* Partner across teams: Translate the needs of dealers, automakers, and partners into clear requirements, and work day-to-day with Engineering, Design, Support, and Go-to-Market teams to deliver, launch, and measure impact.

  
**What We’re Looking For**
  
  

* Around 5+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience in a technical product, integration, API, or platform role. Strong early-career candidates with a technical background are encouraged to apply.

  

* Exposure to integrations, APIs, or platform and marketplace products, with the ability to read technical documentation and discuss APIs, webhooks, and data flows with engineers. (An API is a defined way for two systems to exchange data; a webhook is an automatic notification one system sends another when something happens. You do not need to write code.)

  

* A strong bias toward measurable outcomes, with comfort using dashboards, metrics, and data to set targets and track progress.

  
• Clear writing skills - the ability to turn messy, ambiguous requirements into crisp specifications and user stories. • Curiosity about AI and how it can automate technical work, plus the drive to improve the tools you use.
  
  

* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work with both technical and non-technical audiences.

  

* The ability to manage ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and make thoughtful trade-offs in a fast-paced environment.

  

* A bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  
**Nice to Have**
  
  

* Interest in or exposure to AI agents, large language models (LLMs), and automated workflows.

  

* Familiarity with the automotive retail world - dealerships, the Dealer Management System (DMS, the core software a dealership runs its business on), or automaker (OEM) certification programs.

  
**Why Join Us**  
  

* Modernize an industry: Help modernize how an entire industry connects its software, moving from slow, hand-built integrations to a fast, AI-powered delivery model.

  

* Work at the frontier of AI delivery: Be hands-on with how AI is used to scope, build, and test real enterprise integrations.

  

* See measurable impact: Own clear, measurable goals and watch your work show up directly in integration health, adoption, and support metrics.

  

* Grow with mentorship: Learn from senior product managers and engineers, with a clear path to grow into broader ownership.

description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

**About the Team & Role**

Expedia Group’s Payments team is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the traveler payment experience, covering how travelers discover, select, and use payment methods at checkout. You’ll set strategy, prioritization, and experimentation for payment selection, flexibility, authorization performance, and recovery across web, mobile web, and native apps. The role blends deep payments expertise with AI product judgment to make payments simple, transparent, and trusted at global scale. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Finance, Risk, Legal, Operations, and brand teams.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

  

* Define and execute the product vision and roadmap for payment selection, payment method presentation, payment flexibility, and checkout interactions.
* Own the payment marketplace experience: decide which methods (cards, wallets, BNPL, local payment methods, installments) to surface, where, and for whom, by traveler, market, device, and trip context.
* Improve checkout conversion by removing friction across payment entry, authentication, authorization, error handling, retries, and recovery.
* Build a rigorous experimentation program, from hypothesis and A/B testing through measurement and scaled rollout of winners.
* Define and deliver AI capabilities such as personalized payment recommendations, intelligent routing, failure prediction, next-best-action recovery, and anomaly detection, partnering with Data Science and Engineering on model evaluation, explainability, privacy, bias, and safe rollout.
* Partner with Payments platform teams to ensure reliable, scalable, reusable capabilities across pay-in, authentication, orchestration, and payment status.
* Use quantitative and qualitative insights (conversion, payment and authentication success, support contacts, customer feedback) to prioritize opportunities and measure impact.
Balance traveler experience against cost, authorization performance, fraud and risk, regulatory needs, and operational efficiency, while aligning multiple EG brands and communicating strategy, risks, and decisions to senior leaders.  

**Minimum Qualifications**

  

* 8 + years of product management experience, with a strong track record building, scaling, or transforming payment products.
* Expert knowledge of the payments ecosystem: payment methods, PSPs, authorization and declines, 3DS, tokenization, wallets, routing, refunds, and failure recovery.
* Proven success designing and optimizing high-converting checkout and payment-selection experiences across web, mobile web, and native apps, using experimentation, analytics, and customer research.
* Experience applying AI/ML to customer-facing products (personalization, decisioning, fraud prevention, optimization), with practical understanding of model evaluation, explainability, privacy, bias, and responsible rollout.
Excellent communication and ability to lead through influence in a matrixed organization, with strong analytical skills, product judgment on trade-offs, and a bias toward measurable outcomes.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience in travel, ecommerce, marketplaces, fintech, or other high-scale transactional businesses.
* Experience with payment orchestration, merchant-of-record models, payment performance optimization, or payment method expansion.
* Experience taking AI-powered products from problem definition and model evaluation through launch, monitoring, and measurable business impact.
* Familiarity with payment economics (processing costs, FX, rebates, routing, vendor performance) and global delivery across local payment methods, currencies, and regulations.
* Experience building products across multiple brands, regions, or business models, and improving post-booking payment experiences (payment updates, scheduled payments, failure recovery, payment status).

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

title: Senior Product Manager - Case Management & BPM
description:
***Where will your career take you next? Let’s find out together.***

  

At Zurich Cover-More, we’re proud to be one of the world’s leading travel insurance and assistance providers*.* Each year, we protect more than 20 million travellers worldwide, making sure we’re there every step of their journey with proactive care, personalised cover and specialist support. Zurich Cover-More partners with many of the world’s best-known brands – think major airlines, travel giants, top banks, credit card providers, and large retailers – to deliver more care, more cover, for all.

  

Launched in December 2024, Zurich Cover-More is the global travel brand of Zurich Insurance Group, one of the world’s leading multi-line insurers. Our family of customer-facing brands includes trusted names like Travel Guard, Cover-More Travel Insurance, Travelex Insurance, Universal Assistance, World Travel Protection, Freely, and Blue Insurance. Together, we’re redefining what it means to travel safely and with confidence. Whether it’s a long-awaited holiday, a last-minute business trip, or an unexpected detour, we deliver in the moments that matter.

  

**About the opportunity:**

When a traveler's bag goes missing or a trip is cancelled, what happens next runs on our operations: claims, policy changes, refunds, documents and service requests. We're moving that work onto one enterprise case management and BPM platform, used by up to 2,000 people across North America and Australia–New Zealand first, then Europe.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own it. You'll decide which processes move first, lead our BPM analysts in the US and India, and work with our implementation partner to deliver workflows that cut handling time and manual effort.

  

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Own the case management and BPM vision, roadmap and backlog across claims, servicing and operations
* Rank processes by value: volume, handling time, errors, customer impact and regulation
* Design processes once and configure them by region, brand and partner
* Apply a clear automation order: API first, RPA where there's no API, people where judgment matters
* Bring in AI where it pays: document intake, triage, next-best action and handler summaries
* Give handlers one workspace for cases, documents and customer context
* Lead the BPM analyst team and set standards for process design and requirements
* Act as Product Owner with our SI partner: epics, acceptance criteria, sprint reviews and sign-off
* Plan rollout, training and adoption with operations leaders in each region
  

**What skills and experience you’ll bring on this journey:**

* 10+ years in product management, operations transformation or BPM
* 5+ years owning a case management or BPM platform such as Pega, Appian, Camunda or ServiceNow
* A track record of automation that measurably cut handling time or cost
* Experience rolling out a shared platform across regions or business units
* Strong process design skills: BPMN, Lean, SLAs and work allocation
* Experience leading analysts and managing SI partners and vendors
* The credibility to bring operations and technology leaders to one plan

**Nice to have**

* Insurance claims, policy servicing or assistance operations experience
* Migration from legacy claims or case systems
* AI in operations: document intake, triage or agent assist
* Lean Six Sigma certification
* BPM platform or Scrum Product Owner certification
  

**Why you’ll love working with us!**

We value optimism, caring, togetherness, reliability, results-orientation, and forward-thinking.

  

We have more than 3000 employees worldwide. We are a global group of digital specialists, actuaries, marketers, doctors, nurses, case managers, claims specialists, finance experts, customer service and corporate services professionals. We share a global purpose to look after travellers, at every step of their journey.

  

**Job flexibility**. We understand the importance of making sure that work fits into your life, not the other way around. Our hybrid approach ensures you can maintain work-life balance with the flexibility of 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home, after an initial training period.

  

**Career growth**. This is an extremely exciting time for us at Zurich Cover-More, as we rapidly expand our business across the globe. We’re committed to helping our people thrive through a comprehensive onboarding experience, continuous professional development, and a supportive work environment that empowers growth at every stage of your career.

  

**Take the time you need, for you and your community**. We encourage you to take the time you need when you need it. We offer regular annual and personal leave benefits along with anniversary leave, volunteer leave and a comprehensive paid parental leave scheme.

  

**Diversity and inclusion**. We respect who you are and thoroughly embrace diversity. Wherever life has taken you, we welcome you to bring your whole self to work. Just be you – because that’s exactly who we’re looking for.

  

**We also offer some other perks including:**

* Mediclaim insurance cover in case of any health emergency
* Coverage under group personal accident insurance
* Flexible and compressed work weeks and hybrid working options.
* Generous range of paid leave – 21 annual leave days, 6 sick leave days, 12 public holidays
* An extra day off for you to take on your birthday or your annual work anniversary.

GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* *Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.*

**An overview of this role**
----------------------------

As a Senior Product Manager for Data Integrations, you'll help GitLab's analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) agents see beyond the data held in GitLab. You'll decide which external systems connect to the Data Insights Platform and Orbit, which integrations come first, and how their data fits into shared models.

Engineering teams plan work, track incidents, monitor production, and manage security findings across different tools. Your challenge is to bring that context together with GitLab's code, merge requests, pipelines, deployments, and vulnerabilities. You'll shape a consistent approach that gives customers a trustworthy picture they can query, report on, and use with agents, rather than another set of disconnected data sources.

This role is based in Bangalore, India. You'll work from home and come to the Bangalore office when needed for business or team activities. You should be based in Bangalore or willing to relocate there.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Set integration priorities using evidence from customers, field teams, and other product managers to identify the biggest gaps in context.
* Shape how external data maps into GitLab's shared data models, including the extract, transform, and load (ETL) approach and the transformations needed to make sources work together.
* Define the customer problems and user groups each integration serves. Partner with engineering to agree on the intended experience, trade-offs, and delivery sequence.
* Translate product decisions into a clear backlog of epics and issues for engineering.
* Define telemetry and adoption signals to understand whether connected data helps customers answer new questions, and use those findings to guide priorities.
* Help shape integration pricing and packaging as the product area matures.
* Use AI coding agents and GitLab to explore data, prototype integrations, and document the intended experience.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* Product management experience, with the ability to connect customer needs to priorities and make trade-offs with incomplete information.
* Strong knowledge of the software development and operations (DevOps) ecosystem, including how planning, security, observability, and IT service management tools fit into engineering workflows.
* A working understanding of data integration, ETL, and data transformation, including how data from different systems maps to a common model. You don't need a background as a data engineer.
* Comfort using AI tools for prototyping and documentation as part of your product work.
* Clear communication about customer problems, close collaboration with engineering, and a habit of using data to evaluate adoption.
* Experience with integration products, data models, or value stream analytics is helpful, but isn't required.

We're part of GitLab's Core Data Products organization, which focuses on insights, analytics, and data-driven decision-making. You'll report to the Vice President of Product Management and join as our third product manager, focused on Data Integrations. You'll work alongside a Principal Product Manager responsible for the Data Insights Platform and dashboards, and a Product Manager focused on Orbit.

GitLab is all-remote, with asynchronous collaboration across regions. Transparency, written communication, and clear decisions are central to how we work. This role has the Bangalore location and in-person requirements described above.

GoDaddy, the world's largest domain name registrar, helps millions of entrepreneurs globally start, grow, and scale their businesses. People come to GoDaddy to name their idea, build a website and logo, sell their products and services, and accept payments. Airo™, our agentic operating system for small businesses, helps entrepreneurs get their idea online, run their business day-to-day, and grow through an integrated identity, presence, and commerce experience.

Domains are where many of those journeys begin. We have over 20 million customers and manage more than 80 million domains. Beyond registration, we run a domain aftermarket for investors and businesses that want to buy or sell a name. **Afternic** is one of the world's largest domain marketplaces, and GoDaddy Auctions is a leading marketplace for expired domains.

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll work on a range of customer problems for both independent entrepreneurs getting their business online and domain investors who buy and sell names at scale. Are you interested in this opportunity? We'd love to hear from you!

* Own and deliver against your squad's Key Results, from problem framing through launch and readout. Learn fast. Ship frequently and set clear assessment criteria before you build
* Stay close to customers. Talk with them, review their feedback, and let their problems set your priorities
* Design and run experiments. Write clear hypotheses, partner with engineering and design to ship quickly, and interpret results honestly. Not every release will produce a statistically significant result. We expect you to find sound ways to measure what's hard to measure, so you know whether a release is moving your goals in the right direction and whether it hurts other key areas
* Use AI as a tool. Apply it to data analysis, UX design iteration, prototyping, and code where it fits, and apply your own judgment to the output
* Partner across time zones with engineering, design, marketing, and support. Communicate clearly in writing and keep decisions visible

#### **Your experience should include...**

* 6+ years of product management experience, with a track record of shipping measurable results
* Experience running A/B tests or other experiments from hypothesis to decision
* Adaptability and comfort with ambiguity and growth mindset that thrives on learning and continuous improvement – progress over perfection
* Skill in pulling relevant data yourself and interpreting it and practical AI fluency. You can describe where it helped you and where you chose not to rely on it
* Strong written and async communication, and comfort working with teammates that we have in other time zones with a focus on solving customer problems over shipping features

**You might also have...**

* Marketplace experience
* Experience with domains, web presence, or e-commerce
* Experience building for small business owners who are growing online
* Experience with financial or investing tools

title: Senior Product Manager (B2B)
description:
**About Refold AI**

Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants.

We've grown rapidly, reaching seven-figure ARR and 30+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM.

Refold AI has raised $6.5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital.

**What you'll do:**

* Where does automation earn trust, and where does a human still need to stay in the loop?
* You will draw that line repeatedly, and the answer will keep changing. How do you price outcomes instead of usage, in an industry that has only ever paid for hours?
* You will own that question commercially and build the model around it. What does it mean for a platform to get smarter across customers without leaking what any one customer knows?
* You will define what learning looks like at the system level.
* How do ISV developers think about reliability when their customers depend on
* integrations running without anyone watching? You will own that experience end to end.
* When something breaks in production for an enterprise customer, who gets told, what do they see, and what can they do about it? You will design that judgment layer.

**What we're looking for:**

* You have shipped something on your own. A side project, a tool, anything you took from zero to working. We are building systems with real complexity. We need someone who has felt the difference between a decision made in a doc and a decision made in code.
* You are technically grounded. You do not write the code, but you understand the structure, the trade-offs, and the failure modes. When engineering says a change costs 40% more compute, you know what that means downstream.
* You think in constraints. When you look at a feature request, the first question is what breaks if we build this, not what we could do with it. Edge cases are not polish. They are often the product.
* You write, not deck. Specs, trade-off docs, design decisions. If you cannot write a crisp two-page spec, the feature is not ready to build.
* You push back. If the scoping is underspecified, say so. If the deadline is not realistic, say so. Disagree clearly and commit once a decision is made

**Experience**

* 5+ years in product in the B2B software industry
* At least 2 of those years on a platform, infrastructure, or developer tool.
* Comfortable with distributed systems concepts: queues, retries, schema versioning, idempotency
* Track record of shipping things that were actually hard, not feature additions on a stable roadmap
* Degree from a top-tier institution, or hands-on product experience at a company known for building hard things. One or the other, not neither.

Come join the QuickBooks Desktop team (part of Mid-Market Segment) as a Senior Staff Product Manager, AI Migration & Onboarding Agent.

QuickBooks is Intuit's flagship accounting software, powering millions of small and mid-sized businesses globally. The Mid-Market team is driving a critical transformation: migrating customers from Desktop to cloud-native platforms.

Today, migration from desktop to cloud is high-friction and high-touch. It slows conversion and strains support capacity. Your mission is to change that by building an AI Agent that guides customers through the entire migration journey, from readiness assessment to data migration, configuration, and first productive use.

This is a zero-to-one role. You will own the vision, strategy, and execution for this agent, working at the intersection of LLMs, agentic architectures, and accounting domain knowledge to turn migration from a barrier into a growth engine.

* Own the AI Migration Agent end-to-end: Define vision, strategy, and roadmap for an AI agent that guides customers through complex product migrations, from readiness assessment through post-migration validation.
* Design for scalability and reuse: Architect the agent as a modular platform capability that can be extended to multiple source systems, customer segments, and net-new onboarding journeys.
* Define AI/Human collaboration: Design patterns where the agent handles routine tasks autonomously and escalates complex decisions to domain experts, support teams, or customers.
* Build the knowledge backbone: Own the agent's knowledge base, including product mapping logic, feature parity data, gap analysis rules, and domain-specific reasoning.

* Lead cross-functional execution: Align engineering, AI/ML, design, data science, sales, care, and operations around an agent-first migration strategy. Partner with platform teams to leverage shared AI infrastructure.

At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
Job Description
  
Technical Product Manager – Lilly USA Data Analytics & AI (DA&AI)
  
At Lilly, we believe in the talent of our workforce. One of the best ways to utilize and develop that talent is to use our existing workforce to fill new and/or open positions. If you are looking for a new position within Lilly, you can view and apply to open roles posted in the internal job posting system. You must meet the minimum qualifications outlined in the job description and have or obtain work authorization in the country where the position is to be considered. When applying internally, your current supervisor will receive notification that you have applied. We encourage employees to discuss the opportunity with their supervisor before applying.
  
  
Path/Level
  
P3
  
Job Title
  
Technical Product Manager, Lilly USA Tech@Lilly – DA&AI
  
Job Function
  
Information Technology
  
Location
  
India – Bangalore
  
Reports to
  
Director, CTI Commercial India, Tech@Lilly
  
  
**Note:** Roles are posted at the lowest level of a band. Employees hired into banded positions transfer at their current level, despite the level indicated in the posting.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The Technical Product Manager (TPM) owns the product vision, roadmap, prioritization and value realization for Lilly USA Commercial Sales data and analytics products. The role translates the needs of Sales Operations, field leadership and commercial teams into trusted, reusable data products and analytical capabilities that improve field effectiveness, customer engagement and business decision-making.
  
This individual-contributor role combines strong Commercial Sales stakeholder partnership with formal product management accountability. It moves beyond demand intake and status coordination to owning product outcomes, roadmap decisions, prioritization, adoption and measurable business value.
  
The TPM owns the Sales vertical product direction and business outcomes while partnering with platform Product Owners, Data Architects, Business Analysts, Scrum Masters, engineering, quality and compliance teams that retain accountability for their respective platform, architecture and delivery responsibilities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Product vision, strategy and roadmap
  
  

* Define and communicate a multi-quarter data-product vision and roadmap for Commercial Sales, aligned with Commercial Unit priorities and the broader Data & AI strategy.
* Translate business problems such as field effectiveness, targeting and customer engagement into validated product opportunities, data requirements and measurable outcomes.
* Prioritize the roadmap and backlog using business value, urgency, strategic alignment, effort, risk, compliance, capacity and dependency trade-offs; make and defend scope decisions with leadership.
* Maintain a transparent roadmap, release outlook and product lifecycle plan, clearly communicating changes in priorities, capacity, funding or dependencies.
* Align the Sales roadmap with reusable enterprise capabilities, platform roadmaps and relevant AI innovation initiatives before approving vertical-specific development.

Product discovery and data-product definition
  
  

* Lead structured discovery with field users, Sales Operations, reporting teams to understand decisions, workflows, unmet needs and pain points before defining solutions.
* Validate problems and proposed product concepts through interviews, workflow observation, prototypes, data analysis, usability testing and field feedback.
* Define the business contract for each Sales data product, including intended consumers, decision use cases, product grain, key identifiers, business definitions, source systems, refresh expectations, quality thresholds, access requirements and service expectations, in partnership with the Business Analyst and Data Architect.
* Maintain a clear product catalogue covering product purpose, business owner, product owner, consumers, lifecycle status, dependencies, service expectations and adoption measures.

End-to-end product delivery and acceptance
  
  

* Own product outcomes from validated opportunity through production adoption, including scope, prioritization, release decisions, enablement and post-launch value tracking.
* Own product priorities, backlog ordering and timely scope decisions; partner with the Business Analyst to translate outcomes into epics, features, user stories, data requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with the Scrum Master so planning refinement, reviews and delivery ceremonies support product priorities and timely decisions.
* Work with data engineers, analysts, ML engineers, quality teams and architects to resolve product questions and make informed value, usability, risk and sequencing trade-offs.
* Establish business acceptance criteria, coordinate UAT with authorized Sales stakeholders and secure business sign-off before release.
* Ensure critical Sales measures are reconciled across source systems, data products and consuming reports before production adoption.
* Coordinate product acceptance and operational handover to downstream analytics and reporting teams, including documentation, access, support ownership and known limitations.
* Track delivery and product health, proactively surfacing risks, dependencies, quality concerns, cost considerations and mitigation decisions.

Stakeholder, portfolio and operating-model leadership
  
  

* Act as the single point of accountability and voice of the product for Commercial business partners, Sales Operations, field leadership and technology stakeholders.
* Lead regular Sales product reviews covering roadmap, value realized, adoption, product health, dependencies, risks and decisions required.
* Lead quarterly demand, capacity and sequencing discussions for the Sales data-product portfolio, balancing business value, urgency, strategic alignment, risk, technical dependencies and available delivery capacity.
* Assess existing enterprise data products, approved patterns and reusable platform capabilities before starting new development.
* Contribute to maintaining the Sales DA&AI operating model, decision rights and RACI, recommending updates when product, platform or delivery accountabilities change.
* Provide concise executive updates and evidence-based investment recommendations, including the consequences of funding, capacity and sequencing decisions.

Data, AI and regulated-environment stewardship
  
  

* Champion and apply architecture, data-governance, privacy, security, quality and compliance standards established by the accountable enterprise teams.
* Promote trusted business definitions, data quality, lineage, appropriate access and a consistent source of truth for Sales and Commercial measures.
* Identify and validate Sales problems that may benefit from analytics, machine learning, generative AI or agentic capabilities.
* Partner with Business Analysts and engineering teams to assess feasibility, data readiness, responsible-AI considerations and measurable business value.
* Support the transition of successful proofs of concept into governed, supportable and adoptable Sales products.

Value realization, adoption and lifecycle management
  
  

* Define success measures before investment and track outcomes after release, using appropriate business, product, data-quality, adoption and delivery measures.
* Drive change management, training, communications and field enablement so intended users adopt and benefit from the products.
* Continuously improve products through evidence-based releases, address low adoption or quality concerns and retire low-value or duplicative capabilities.

Role Accountability and Decision Rights
  
  
The TPM is accountable for why the product is needed, whom it serves, what outcomes it must deliver, what is prioritized and whether value is realized. The TPM partners with the Business Analyst on detailed requirements, the Scrum Master on delivery ceremonies, the Data Architect on architecture and governance standards, engineering and quality teams on implementation and validation, and platform Product Owners on reusable capabilities and technical roadmaps.
  
  
Qualifications and Skills
  
  
Required
  
  

* Relevant experience in technology, data, analytics or digital product delivery, including substantial experience owning data, analytics or AI products in complex enterprise environments.
* Proven record of owning product discovery, vision, roadmap, prioritization, delivery, adoption and lifecycle management in an Agile environment such as Scrum or SAFe.

The role ensures that regulatory- and process-driven changes are delivered within applicable GxP, compliance, data-use and data-access requirements and within strategic and financial guardrails agreed with the Product Manager in line with Tech leadership direction. Working closely with business stakeholders and external partners, the Product Owner defines outcomes and ensures delivered functionality is usable, secure, compliant, supportable and aligned to product strategy.

Strategic investment, major architecture and cross-product trade-offs that exceed delegated authority are escalated to the Product Manager, who coordinates further escalation to the Product Domain Lead or Tech leadership team in line with agreed decision rights.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional needs, refine requirements and define product outcomes and maintain alignment throughout delivery.
* Lead end-to-end product delivery across the complex ePI ecosystem, guiding Product Analysts and coordinating Engineers, Architects, Testers, enterprise platform teams and external partners to ensure solutions are fit for purpose, secure, compliant, supportable and aligned to applicable standards.

title: Senior Product Manager - Managed Security Services
description:
**#RunwiththePack**
===================

  

At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to **end cyber risk** .

  

We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.

  

More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.

  

We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

**About the Position:**
=======================

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a **Senior Product Manager - Endpoint Security Cloud Platform** to be part of making that happen.

**Position Overview**

The Senior Product Manager, Endpoint Security Cloud Platform will own the cloud backend capabilities that underpin Arctic Wolf’s Endpoint Security portfolio, including administration, policy and configuration management, device registration and enrollment, and agent lifecycle management. Based in Bangalore, India, this is a technical, product-facing role that partners closely with Engineering and Architecture to define requirements, make product decisions, and deliver at scale. The role will be central to two of the team’s most significant initiatives: defining the cloud side of our unified agent strategy, consolidating four endpoint agents and two cloud backends into a single agent and a single cloud; and planning and executing the migration of several million endpoints from one cloud backend to another.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Ownership – Cloud Platform**

* Own the product definition, roadmap, and prioritized backlog for Endpoint Security cloud backend capabilities, including administration, policy and configuration management, device registration and enrollment, multi-tenancy, and agent lifecycle management (deployment, upgrade, and health).

* Translate Endpoint Security strategy into clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, partnering with Engineering and Architecture on system design, data flows, APIs, and technical trade-offs.

* Serve as product owner for one or more development teams, owning the definition, prioritization, and hygiene of the backlog from concept through delivery.

* Partner with UX to define administrator and operator workflows that are simple, scalable, and consistent across the Endpoint Security portfolio.

  

**Agent Consolidation & Cloud Migration**

* Define the cloud-side requirements for the unified agent initiative, consolidating four endpoint agents and two cloud backends into one agent and one cloud, including feature parity, data model alignment, and deprecation sequencing.

* Plan and drive the migration of several million endpoints between cloud backends, including migration strategy, phasing, rollback and risk mitigation, customer and partner impact, and success criteria.

* Work with Engineering, Managed Services, Support, and Customer Success to ensure migrations are seamless for customers, partners, and security analysts.

  

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Serve as the product point of contact for cloud platform capabilities across Engineering, Security Research, Managed Services, Support, and Customer Success.

* Ensure endpoint cloud capabilities integrate with Arctic Wolf’s broader platform and managed security services, improving analyst workflows, detection and response outcomes, and the customer experience.

* Engage directly with customers, partners, and internal users to gather first-hand requirements, validate solutions, and understand operational challenges at scale.

* Brief Endpoint Security product leadership on roadmap status, delivery plans, and risks, and provide technical input to Product Marketing as needed.

  

**Metrics & Quality**

* Define and track product success metrics for cloud platform capabilities, spanning deployment and adoption, migration progress, platform reliability and performance, product quality, and customer satisfaction.

  

**Key Qualifications**

**Experience & Expertise**

* 5+ years of product management experience, including at least 3 years as a product manager at an endpoint security vendor (EPP, EDR, or XDR).

* Demonstrated ownership of a technically complex endpoint security product through multiple stages of its lifecycle, ideally including the cloud management console or backend services that administer endpoint agents.

* Experience working in high-growth organizations with globally distributed product and engineering teams.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

  

**Technical Acumen**

* Sufficient technical depth to make product decisions involving endpoint agents, agent-to-cloud communication, device enrollment and identity, policy distribution, telemetry pipelines, and operating-system considerations across Windows, macOS, and Linux.

* Strong understanding of cloud-native SaaS architecture, including multi-tenant services, APIs, microservices, identity and access management, and public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

* Ability to understand customer IT environments, company products, and services at a system, data flow, and API level.

* Hands-on experience with agile development practices and serving as product owner for engineering teams.

  

**Product Skills & EQ**

* Strong decision-making and follow-through, including defining the problem, evaluating alternatives and trade-offs, and measuring results against success criteria.

* Highly detail oriented, with the ability to manage complex dependencies across multiple teams and workstreams.

* Clear, concise written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical concepts to engineers, leadership, and customers.

* High EQ and a collaborative approach to partnering across functional teams and time zones.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading large-scale endpoint or cloud migrations, product consolidation, or re-platforming initiatives.

* Experience with device management, enrollment, or provisioning at scale (e.g., MDM/UEM or similar).

* Prior hands-on technical background, such as software engineering, solutions architecture, or sales engineering, before moving into product management.

**On-Camera Policy**

To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

**Benefits**
============

  

All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:

  

* Equity for all employees
* 18 days annual leave, flexible holidays & festivals, and paid volunteer days
* Training and career development programs
* Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance.
A modern workplace in Helios Business Park in Bengaluru  

**Security Requirements**
=========================

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

Depending on the role and where permitted by applicable law, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory, security, or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws, and authorization requirements where applicable.

  

**Your next big opportunity starts here — apply today and help us end cyber risk.**

* Own the BYOD proposition end to end — the privacy commitment, the employee terms, the enrolment journey and the trust that makes people willing to participate.
* Manage the mobile OS release cycle as a recurring product event: annual iOS and Android major releases, beta assessment, compatibility validation and controlled rollout.
* Own the product relationship with mobile carriers, MDM platform vendors and app suppliers.
* Build and maintain relationships across business units, regions and functions; run a stakeholder forum or product council that makes trade-offs visible rather than fought in private.
* Partner with Cyber Security to land control changes in ways employees will accept and comply with — security outcomes delivered through good product design rather than mandate.
* Engage works councils, employee representatives and Privacy where mobile telemetry, BYOD or device monitoring is in scope.
* Report on product performance to senior stakeholders in outcome terms.

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent demonstrable professional experience.
* Product ownership certifications desirable (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), SAFe POPM, Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO), ITIL v4 Foundation, Microsoft Endpoint Administrator Associate).

* Product or service ownership serving 10,000+ users across multiple countries.
* Demonstrable hands-on product experience in end user computing, digital workplace or mobile device management — including direct familiarity with an enterprise MDM/UEM platform.
* Sustained experience owning a backlog for a cross-functional agile squad, through multiple release cycles, in a scaled delivery environment.
* Track record of using user research and quantitative telemetry to drive prioritisation, with a specific example of a decision the data changed.
* A demonstrable product outcome delivered and measured — adoption, experience, effort or cost — not merely a feature shipped.
* Proven ability to manage senior and conflicting stakeholders across business units and regions, and to hold a prioritisation decision under pressure.
* Fluent English; credible with both engineers and executives in a global matrixed organisation.
* Willingness to travel internationally, approximately [10–15]% of the time — including to sites, labs and field locations where the devices are actually used.

* Product ownership for specialised or frontline mobile devices: rugged handhelds, lab and clinical devices, field-force tablets, shared/kiosk devices, scanners and shop-floor endpoints.
* Experience with deskless and frontline worker populations — employees without a corporate laptop, whose primary device is shared or personal.
* Works council and employee-representation engagement, particularly on BYOD, mobile telemetry and device monitoring.
* Mobile app product experience — internal app store curation, in-house mobile app lifecycle, MAM policy design.
* Experience delivering a major platform migration or transition as a product owner — MDM platform change, MSP transition, or BYOD programme launch.
* Service design or UX research background; journey mapping and service blueprinting.
* Carrier and telecom management — mobile contracts, eSIM, international roaming, expense management.

* Accessibility and assistive technology as a designed-in part of the device proposition.

We are hiring a Staff, AI Product Manager to own Emerging Tech and AI Tooling, the front edge of GSK’s AI platform estate. You will run structured evaluation of new AI tools and platforms, decide what graduates into a standing tower and what gets retired, and own the AI developer tooling GSK engineers use every day. You will lead a small engineering squad and set direction a far larger estate inherits.

**Why This Role Exists**:

Every week brings a new AI tool and a stakeholder who wants it. Without a disciplined front door, evaluations never close and nothing is ever retired. This role runs that front door, and owns the developer tooling estate so the tools engineers depend on daily have a named owner rather than a shared inbox.

In this role you will be the person who:

* Owns the evaluation portfolio for new AI tools and platforms across Enterprise AI.
* Decides what graduates into a standing platform tower, what holds, and what gets retired.
* Owns the AI developer tooling estate end to end.
* Hands graduated platforms over with a working operating model.

This is not a traditional enterprise product role managing a source system’s roadmap, releases, and backlog. As an AI Product Manager in Enterprise AI, you:

* Build new AI products from ambiguous, unsolved business problems.

* **Communicate impact clearly** in language that connects tooling investment to engineering throughput and enterprise outcomes.

--------------------------------------

* **Apply Enterprise AI’s value-realization framework** to every evaluation and graduation and improve it with what you learn.
* **Run honest post-mortems** on evaluations that failed, and feed lessons back into how the front door selects what to test.

* Experience leading a small engineering team while operating with a span of influence far wider than the headcount — leading through frameworks, evidence, and quality of thinking.
* A product management or product-strategy heritage: discovery, opportunity sizing, roadmap shaping, prototyping, and stakeholder alignment — ideally on products whose core behaviour is AI rather than conventional software.

**Preferred skills:**

* Hands on with the AI platform ecosystem as a daily practitioner: fluent in how the landscape is categorised, where the category boundaries actually fall, and which capabilities are genuinely distinct from each other.
* Able to evaluate from first principles and to design the evaluation itself: set the hypothesis, the success bar, the comparison set, and the decision date, and defend the method to engineers and vendors alike.
* A proven record of retiring and consolidating technology, including at least one tool killed on evidence.

description:
Senior Product Manager — KYC Platform
  
  
Build the onboarding backbone that powers every credit product PayU Finance owns.
  
  
ABOUT PAYU FINANCE INDIA
  
  
PayU Finance India Limited is one of India's fastest-growing digital lending businesses, operating at the intersection of payments, credit, and technology. Through our flagship consumer product LazyPay and a rapidly expanding suite of merchant lending solutions, we serve millions of Indians with instant, responsible credit — making financial access simple, fair, and digital-first.
  
  
We are building the credit infrastructure for the next 500 million Indians. As a regulated NBFC backed by Prosus, one of the world's largest technology investors, we combine the agility of a startup with the governance of a regulated financial institution. Our teams solve hard problems in underwriting, platform engineering, compliance, and product — at scale, in real time.
  
  
ABOUT THE ROLE
  
  
As the Senior Product Manager for KYC Platform at PayU Finance, you will own the end-to-end Know Your Customer (KYC) infrastructure that underpins every lending product we operate — LazyPay consumer credit, merchant lending, BNPL, co-lending, and future lines of business. This is a platform role, not a product feature role. You will think in systems: designing scalable, partner-agnostic KYC journeys that can be configured, extended, and reused across business units. You will work closely with Compliance, Legal, Engineering, Data, and external partners including KYC bureaus, video-KYC vendors, DigiLocker, UIDAI, and banking correspondents. You will set the gold standard for compliant, frictionless onboarding at PayU Finance.
  
  
WHAT YOU WILL DO
  
  
**Define and own the KYC Platform roadmap:** design a modular, API-first KYC platform that serves all internal business units as internal consumers — eliminating duplication and enabling faster product launches.
  
**Drive platform thinking:** abstract KYC flows into reusable components (identity verification, liveness, document parsing, de-dup, risk flagging) and define clear platform contracts for product teams to build on.
  
**Lead partner integration strategy:** evaluate, onboard, and manage integrations with KYC vendors (CKYC, video-KYC, DigiLocker, UIDAI, PAN validation, face-match), negotiate SLAs, and own fallback logic.
  
**Translate regulatory requirements into product specs:** work alongside Compliance and Legal to convert RBI, PMLA, and FATF guidelines into product requirements — including re-KYC cycles, audit trail design, and data retention policies.
  
**Build with data:** define KYC funnel metrics, drop-off analytics, and fraud signals. Use data to reduce onboarding friction while maintaining regulatory thresholds. Continuously A/B test and iterate on the onboarding journey.
  
**Enable developer experience:** define clear API specifications, documentation, and sandbox environments so product and engineering teams across PayU Finance can self-serve on KYC without ad-hoc requests.
  
**Plan for scale and longevity:** architect KYC flows that can handle 10x volume, support new product lines (UPI credit, co-lending, embedded finance), and adapt to evolving RBI regulations without re-engineering from scratch.
  
**Drive governance:** own the KYC health dashboard — approval rates, STP rates, failure categorisation, re-KYC compliance, audit readiness — and present to senior leadership and regulators.
  
  
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
  
  
**Platform product experience:** 6–9 years in product management with at least 2–3 years owning a platform or infrastructure product — ideally in fintech, payments, or financial services.
  
**Regulated entity experience:** hands-on experience working within an RBI-regulated NBFC, bank, or payment aggregator — you understand what compliance means when there is a penalty for getting it wrong.
  
**Technical depth:** you can read API documentation, review a system design, and hold your own in an engineering discussion. You understand OAuth flows, webhook architectures, and data pipelines.
  
**Data-driven mindset:** you define success with metrics before you build. You are comfortable running SQL queries, interpreting funnel analytics, and building the business case from data.
  
**Partner management:** you have experience evaluating and onboarding third-party vendors, writing integration requirement documents, and managing SLA accountability.
  
**Long-term systems thinking:** you do not build for the next quarter — you design for the next three years. You document architectural decisions and think about backward compatibility, versioning, and deprecation.
  
**Communication:** you can write a one-pager that makes a compliance officer and an engineer agree on priorities. You communicate clearly, escalate appropriately, and drive alignment without authority.
  
  
GOOD TO HAVE
  
  
Experience in KYC/AML domain — CKYC, V-CIP, DigiLocker, UIDAI API integrations
  
**Knowledge of lending workflows:** loan origination, credit bureau pulls, underwriting triggers
  
Exposure to co-lending or white-label lending platforms
  
Familiarity with PMLA, RBI Master Directions on KYC (2016, as updated), and FATF guidelines
  
Experience with identity fraud detection, liveness check providers, or device intelligence
  
  
WHY PAYU FINANCE?
  
  
Own a platform product that will directly power India's next wave of digital credit — from consumer to merchant to embedded finance
  
Work at the intersection of product, compliance, and engineering in one of India's most complex regulatory environments
  
Build from the ground up — this role has significant greenfield opportunity to set the architecture, not just maintain it
  
Be part of a Prosus-backed, profitable business with the scale of a large company and the decision-making speed of a startup

description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**

**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours.**

You are responsible for ensuring that projects are successfully completed on time and on budget. This includes project governance, budget and timeline development, build quality, testing and operational readiness, and the completed project’s readiness to go live.

**How you will contribute**

You will:

* Drive consistency and quality in the execution of projects using the appropriate methodology and tools
* Identify, assess, and mitigate project-level risks and escalate them to global leads and/ or the program manager when needed
* Provide project reporting and status updates using scorecards, status reports and monthly review meetings and leading stakeholder meetings
* Lead budget management, resource planning and utilization
* Confirm the completion and consistency of projects and their readiness to go live
* Own the relationship with the external vendors including quality assurance in all phases of project delivery

**What you will bring**

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:

* Proven experience in project management methodology
* Excellent communication skills and able to drive effective discussions with project resources from tactical execution level up to steering committee members
* Excellent project planning and proactiveness in identifying risks and mitigations and managing strict timelines
* Strong focus on cost, schedule and quality of project delivery
* Knowledge of relevant business processes and related technology solutions
* Stakeholder management and ability to influence positively in decision making
* Proven ability in building effective teams across internal and external partners
* Strong conceptual and analytic skills – enjoys problem solving

**About the Role**

The CLM (Contract Lifecycle Management) Product Lead owns the end-to-end product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Mondelez International's CLM platform. Operating primarily within the DocuSign CLM ecosystem and connected procurement tools, this role bridges Legal, Procurement, R&D, Sales, and business stakeholders to drive adoption, optimize contract processes, and deliver measurable commercial value.

**Product Vision & Strategy**

* Define and communicate the CLM product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with enterprise goals and MDLZ procurement transformation objectives.

* Establish product KPIs and success metrics, and report progress to senior stakeholders on a regular cadence.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and own the Contract Product roadmap and strategy, translating business needs into a prioritized delivery plan.
* Drive CLM deployment across Legal, Procurement, R&D, Sales, and other business functions, ensuring consistent adoption and change management.
* Oversee ongoing platform support, including issue resolution, enhancement requests, and release management.
* Lead contract compliance management by ensuring contractual obligations are tracked and fulfilled, proactively identifying and preventing contract value leakage.
* Manage and develop a team focused on achieving zero contract value leakage across the enterprise through the Statement Review Process.
* Develop a Strategy for deploying Amazon Quick Agents for CLM.
* Stakeholder Management.
* Partner with Legal, Procurement, R&D, Sales, and business units to gather requirements, prioritize features, and manage expectations.
* Facilitate governance forums (Steering committees, Product Councils) to build consensus around roadmap trade-offs.

**Domain Knowledge**

* Deep understanding of the full contract lifecycle: authoring, negotiation, approval workflows, execution, obligation management, and renewal.
* Familiarity with procurement and sourcing processes as they relate to contract creation and management.
* Hands-on experience with CLM platforms and comfort with API/MCP integrations, data migration, and metadata modelling.
* Understanding of eSignature tools and requirements across geographies.
* Ability to engage credibly with IT architects and developers.
* Adjacent Procurement Tools: Experience with Coupa, Hicx, Sievo for spend analytics, and process orchestration platforms such as Pega or ServiceNow.
* AI/ML-Driven Contract Analytics: Exposure to clause extraction, obligation tracking, risk scoring, and GenAI-assisted contract authoring.
* Experience in SAP and integrations is a plus.

**Vendor & Partner Management**

* Manage the relationship with the CLM vendor - evaluate new modules, AI features, integrations, and licensing.
* Represent MDLZ in vendor roadmap sessions and user community forums to influence product direction.

No Relocation support available

**Business Unit Summary**
-------------------------

### **At Mondelēz International, our purpose is to empower people to snack right by offering the right snack, for the right moment, made the right way. That means delivering a broad range of delicious, high-quality snacks that nourish life's moments, made with sustainable ingredients and packaging that consumers can feel good about.**

### **We have a rich portfolio of strong brands globally and locally including many household names such as** ***Oreo*****,** ***belVita*** **and** ***LU*** **biscuits;** ***Cadbury Dairy Milk*****,** ***Milka*** **and** ***Toblerone*** **chocolate;** ***Sour Patch Kids*** **candy and** ***Trident*** **gum. We are proud to hold the top position globally in biscuits, chocolate and candy and the second top position in gum.**

### **Our 80,000 makers and bakers are located in more** **than 80 countries** **and we sell our products in** **over 150 countries** **around the world. Our people are energized for growth and critical to us living our purpose and values. We are a diverse community that can make things happen—and happen fast.**

Mondelēz International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

description:
Cin7 is a fast-growing global software company that provides solutions for modern-day product sellers. We help these sellers keep track of their inventory at scale, and help them sell their products across multiple sales channels around the world.

Cin7 is expanding very quickly with a mission to become the leading Inventory Management Software brand in the world, and we are looking for a motivated and driven individual to join the team.

Cin7 India is proud of our culture and has been officially recognised with Great Place to Work® Certification™.

### **How you'll make an impact:**

As a Product Manager with AI experience, you are the link between our users and our engineering team. You will work with users to understand what they need, and you will have the technical skills to work with engineers to deliver it. A key part of the role is finding where AI can save our customers time and effort in inventory management, and turning those opportunities into features that enterprise users love and trust.

You will explore and shape product ideas by interviewing customers, studying competitors, and testing new technology, including AI models, tools, and open source options. There are many good ideas, but only some can be built. You will work with UX, engineering, and leadership to choose the ones that matter most, and to decide where AI is the right answer and where a simpler solution works better.

### **What you'll do:**

* Turn business goals into clear software requirements.
* Find and define AI use cases for Core, such as forecasting, data entry, search, and automation of routine tasks, and write the requirements for each.
* Rank features based on market research, customer need, and company strategy.
* Manage project scope by making trade-offs between time and cost, and between security and speed.
* Set success measures for AI features, such as accuracy, time saved, and user adoption, and track them after launch.
* Work with engineers to decide how to build, test, and monitor AI features, including how we handle wrong or unexpected results.
* Work with Security, Legal, and Engineering to handle customer data responsibly in AI features, including privacy, data use, and cost of running the models.
* Rank feature requests from the development teams.
* Set the product vision and work closely with the technical team to define specifications.
* Make sure the product meets business goals and user needs.
* Track progress against plan and fix variances as soon as they appear.
* Make trade-offs between features, schedule, and cost, based on business goals, company policies, software architecture, and team capacity.

### **What you'll bring:**

* Proven work experience in product management or as an associate product manager, preferably in B2B SaaS, with inventory management, supply chain, or ecommerce domain experience a plus.
* Hands-on experience shipping at least one product or feature that uses AI or machine learning, including large language models.
* Working understanding of how AI features are built and tested, such as prompts, model selection, evaluation, accuracy, and data quality. You do not need to write code.
* Awareness of AI risks, including incorrect answers, bias, privacy, and cost, and how to reduce them.
* Proven track record of managing a successful product through its full lifecycle.
* Proven ability to develop product and marketing strategies and present recommendations to executive management.
* Structured approach and experience with agile methods.
* History of working with development teams to get results.
* Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to roll up your sleeves.
* Skilled at working with cross-functional teams in a matrix organization.
* Enthusiasm for new technology and a practical view of what it can and cannot do.
* Ability to be productive in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

### **Why Work for Us?**

* We are a fast growing business going through a huge amount of growth.
* You’ll have the opportunity to work on products that are used by our global customer-base and at the same time you’ll be growing your career and developing new skills.
* Work From Anywhere for 30 days in a six month period
* Celebrate your birthday with a paid day off
* A Global Cin7 Day celebrated companywide, providing you a dedicated holiday to focus on your own wellbeing.
* Recruitment referral bonus
* Work for a Great Place to Work®

**Why CIN7?**

CIN7 is a leader in one of the most exciting software verticals right now, and we're growing exponentially. We're looking to add people to our team who are passionate about working with a fast growth tech company.

At CIN7, we make great products available to everyone. Every month, millions of sales orders flow through our platform reducing the cost, effort and time for product sellers so they can quickly get products to customers and build their brands without worrying about their operations. We pride ourselves on providing Inventory Management and Supply Chain software to help medium-large product businesses thrive in a highly competitive, digital world. CIN7 centrally manages inventory across multiple locations and channels, connecting 500+ systems to support receiving, selling and shipping stock.

***We value diversity at Cin7, and bring people into the heart of everything we do. We hire, recruit, and promote without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. We understand the importance of creating a safe and comfortable work environment and encourage individualism and authenticity in every member of our team.***

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
